title: fix(plugin-detail): show the action's option label on the record history badge
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR9wsxdgKzces31XWg

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbPt4BqVrm2MVcQn63SRJQJh)_

Fixes #28894

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页「历史」时间线的动作徽章,不再把存储值大写后直接显示,而是显示来源字段选项的翻译标签。`HistoryTimeline` 新增可选属性 `actionField`(`{ object, field }`),用 `useSafeFieldLabel().fieldOptionLabel` 读服务端下发的翻译;`record:history` 自取数据时指明来源是 `sys_activity.type`,所以中文界面显示「已更新」「已创建」。
- 为什么改:中文用户打开任何记录的历史标签页,都看到英文大写的 UPDATED / CREATED,旁边的摘要却是中文。翻译早已下发,只是徽章没有用。与卡片原文的偏差:徽章的值来自 `sys_activity.type`(`updated` / `created`),不是 `sys_audit_log.action`(`update` / `create`),席位已按此修订认领。
- 风险与回滚:没有翻译标签的值、以及宿主自行传入的条目,仍按存储值大写显示,英文界面外观不变。不改元数据、不改协议、不发新请求。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/HistoryTimeline.tsx`(徽章的 `actionLabel` 与 `uppercase` 条件)、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-history.tsx`(`SELF_FETCH_ACTION_FIELD`)。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/HistoryTimeline.actionLabel-28894.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-history.actionLabel-28894.test.tsx`,预期 6 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`HistoryTimeline`** takes an optional `actionField` prop, `{ object, field }`, naming the select field the entries' `action` values come from. Each badge shows `useSafeFieldLabel().fieldOptionLabel(object, field, value, value)`: the option's label in the active language from the served translations, the same read the record page makes for any select option label. A value with no label, and every value when `actionField` is not given, shows as stored. The `uppercase` class now applies only to a value shown as stored, so a translated label is drawn as the translation spells it.
- **`record:history`** passes `{ object: 'sys_activity', field: 'type' }` for the entries it fetches itself, because its self-fetch maps each `sys_activity` row's `type` to the entry's `action`. Entries a host passes in name no source and keep the stored value.
- The badge tone (`ACTION_VARIANT`) still keys on the stored value. No new request, no ui map of action labels.

## Why

The HotCRM lead page's History tab printed `UPDATED` / `CREATED` beside Chinese summaries, although the option labels were already translated and served.

**Deviation from the card's text (claim amendment 6568854052).** The card names `sys_audit_log.action` as the label source. Measured at `origin/main` `9a9823d9` and HotCRM `d4ffe99`, the reproduced badge reads `sys_activity.type` instead:

- The lead History tab is an authored `record:history` block (HotCRM `src/sales/pages/lead_detail.page.ts`). It has no host entries, so the block self-fetches `sys_activity` and maps `action: r.type`.
- The badges seen, `UPDATED` / `CREATED`, are the `sys_activity.type` values `updated` / `created`. `sys_audit_log.action` stores `update` / `create`.
- The row text (更新了 线索 …：职位) is the `sys_activity` summary (`plugin-audit` `activityUpdatedFields`).
- On the synthesized record page the `sys_audit_log` read feeds `record:activity`, not `HistoryTimeline`.

So the badge reads the option labels of `sys_activity.type` (zh-CN: 已更新 / 已创建). The card's intent is unchanged: labels come from the declared options through the served translations, the raw value is the fallback, and the ui holds no map.

## Tests

- New `HistoryTimeline.actionLabel-28894.test.tsx`: zh shows 已更新 / 已创建 without `uppercase`; a value with no option label shows as stored, upper-cased; en keeps the upper-cased look where the label is the stored word; no `actionField` shows every value as stored. The bundle is built with `transformSpecTranslations`, the transform the console applies to `/api/v1/i18n/translations/:locale`.
- New `record-history.actionLabel-28894.test.tsx`: the self-fetch labels its badges from `sys_activity.type` in zh; host entries keep the stored value.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with the blob restored to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards:
  - `record-history` stops passing the source (`actionField={undefined}`): 1 red, the self-fetch zh case.
  - The label read is removed (`fieldOptionLabel(…)` replaced by the stored value): 2 red, the zh cases of both files.
  - `uppercase` applied unconditionally: 2 red, the zh cases of both files.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1 (zh labels): at head `f7a834c5`, a `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh` server, signed in as the dev admin, served `GET /api/v1/i18n/translations/zh-CN` with `objects.sys_activity.fields.type.options` = `created: 已创建, updated: 已更新, …` (twelve options). The en bundle serves each option as its value (`updated: updated`). The console flattens that document into the `fieldOptions` keys `fieldOptionLabel` reads, which is the shape the unit tests build. The served document is in the project files at `issue-28894/served-zh-CN-translations.json`. NOT MEASURED: a browser run of the built console on a record's History tab, because it needs `pnpm console:build`.
- Acceptance 2 (fallback): a value with no option label (for example a custom `activityMilestones[].type`) shows as stored.
- Acceptance 3 (`uppercase`): it applies only to a value shown as stored. English badges look as before, because the en label is the stored word.
- `HistoryTimelineProps`, which is exported, gains one optional member (`actionField`), and the package entry now exports its type `HistoryActionField`. That widens a published type, so the declaration is `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (claim amended on the card); the changeset stays `patch` with `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- Outside this card: `DetailView`'s own history tab (`schema.history.entries`) names no source, so its badges keep the stored value. `ACTION_VARIANT` keys are `sys_audit_log` actions (`update`, `create`, …), so every `sys_activity` entry gets the neutral outline tone, as it did before this PR. Noted, not filed.
